patthana16.84:1.1: sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anidassana appaṭighaṃ sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, …pe… anidassana appaṭighaṃ sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho sappītiko ca na anidassana sappaṭigho na sappītiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.84:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ appītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na appītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anidassana appaṭighaṃ appītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana sappaṭigho na appītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, anidassana appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na sappītiko ca anidassana sappaṭigho na appītiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ
